# LzToL

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/LzToL`

```text
usage : 

  -h, --help : display this help
  --lz-file : name of the file containing the lz sorted spectrum
  --precision : precision used to compare two energy values (default value = 9.9999999999999995e-08)
  -f, --full : indicates that all Lz value are contained in the file (if not L output will have one less value that the Lz counterpart)
  --meanl-column : index of the column that contains mean L value. If negative, use only the energy to guess the L value. (default value = -1)
  --check-meanl : check if the L mean value is valid (i.e. is an integer up to a given error bar and compatible with the Lz value).
  --meanl-error : allowed error on the L mean value (default value = 1e-10)
  --sort-l : sort l values from the smallest to the largest one
```
